title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate - System Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Associate \- System Engineer to support the maintenance and reliability of our internal systems, servers, and infrastructure. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or early\-career professionals who want to build strong foundational knowledge in Linux systems, networking, infrastructure operations, and security practices.
 



 The selected candidate will work closely with senior engineers to maintain infrastructure stability and gradually gain exposure to cloud platforms, automation tools, and DevSecOps practices.
 



 This role provides a strong learning path towards Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, and DevSecOps roles within the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in maintaining internal servers, systems, and infrastructure environments.
* Monitor system performance, services, and alerts to ensure high availability.
* Support routine system maintenance, patching, and updates.
* Assist in server setup, configuration, and troubleshooting under supervision.
* Monitor backup processes and verify successful backup operations.
* Review system logs and report anomalies or potential issues.
* Assist in maintaining infrastructure documentation and system configurations.
* Provide basic technical support related to infrastructure systems when required.
* Support troubleshooting of system and network issues alongside senior engineers.
* Participate in improving infrastructure reliability and operational processes.



  





**Requirements** 



* Basic understanding of
 **Linux operating systems**
* Basic knowledge of
 **networking concepts** 
 (IP, DNS, HTTP, firewalls)
* Familiarity with
 **system troubleshooting and command\-line usage**
* Basic understanding of computer systems and infrastructure concepts
* Interest in
 **cloud computing, infrastructure automation, and security**
* Basic scripting knowledge (Bash / Shell / Python – beginner level acceptable)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Willingness to learn and work in infrastructure and security domains
* Good communication and teamwork skills



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 2025 / 2026 Pass out \- Diploma / Degree / B.Tech in IT, Computer Science, or related field
 



 Exposure to Linux environments through projects or coursework
 



 Basic awareness of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
 



 Understanding of virtualization concepts
 



 Any relevant certifications or courses in Linux, Cloud, or Networking are a plus
 



 Any DevOps or Cloud fundamentals certification
 



  





**Benefits** 




**A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.**

title: Major Incident Manager - Outage Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title : Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager**
**Job Summary:**
 The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a critical role responsible for managing and resolving high\-impact incidents that affect the services and operations of our organization. The individual in this position will be expected to lead and coordinate the response to major incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations and maintaining communication with all stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IT service management, exceptional problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work under pressure. The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a vital role that requires a dedicated professional capable of navigating high\-stress situations and delivering results. If you have the experience, skills, and certifications required, and are ready to take on this challenging yet rewarding position, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Key Job Requirements:**
* Lead the process of incident management from detection to resolution and post\-incident review.
* Coordinate with IT teams, business units, and external vendors to manage major incidents effectively.
* Communicate effectively with all levels of management and stakeholders during major incidents.
* Write high quality incident/outage communications with zero defect.
* Ensure that all incidents are logged, tracked, and documented in accordance with EY’s Incident Management policies and procedures.
* Develop and maintain the Major Incident Management Plan and ensure it is followed during incidents.
* Conduct post\-incident analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
* Excellent collaborator with people at all levels to solve high impact incidents within agreed SLA for Major Incidents.
* Ability to escalate and engage support resources based on established EY’s Major Incident Management process.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* (Describe the knowledge or skills needed to perform this job; these may be technical, managerial or behavioral in nature.)
* A minimum of 10\+ years of industry experience in a Major Incident Management or Outage Management role.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and practices.
* Proven track record of successfully managing and resolving major incidents in a complex IT environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze complex situations and make sound decisions quickly.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking, and application systems.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices.
* Good understanding of ServiceNow Incident and Major Incident Management module.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
* No direct supervision responsibilities, but demonstrable ability to lead bridge calls related to high\-impact incidents and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, with the aim of restoring services as soon as possible.


**Other Requirements:**
* Mandatory qualifying criterion: Candidates must be willing and able to work in a 24x7 rotating shift model, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
* This is a Kochi\-based role and requires working from the office only.
* Willingness to be on\-call to respond to high\-priority incidents as they occur.


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Experience:**
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in Major Incident Management or a similar role within the IT industry.


**Certification Requirements:**
* ITIL Foundation certification required; intermediate ITIL certification preferred.

description:
Job Title: Cybersecurity \- Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Senior analyst
   

  

 Experience: 4\-8 Years
   

  

 Location: Infopark, Kochi (Work from Office)
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Analyst \- Identity \& Access Management (IAM) to
   

  

 support and enhance enterprise identity security, access governance, and privileged access
   

  

 management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID,
   

  

 Active Directory, Hybrid Identity, Identity Governance, and Privileged Access Management
   

  

 while ensuring secure and compliant user access across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Administer and support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid


 identity environments.
   

  

* Manage user lifecycle processes including provisioning, modifications, deprovisioning,


 and access governance.
   

  

* Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra Connect (Azure AD Connect) and hybrid


 identity synchronization.
   

  

* Implement and manage Conditional Access, MFA, Authentication Strength Policies,


 Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
   

  

* Conduct access reviews, user access recertification, and identity governance activities.
* Support and maintain SSO integrations using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and LDAP


 protocols.
   

  

* Implement and manage Just\-in\-Time (JIT) privileged access and privileged account


 controls.
   

  

* Support PAM integrations and enterprise privileged access solutions.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, directory synchronization, and identity


 related issues.
   

  

* Automate identity administration tasks using PowerShell.
* Support identity integrations for enterprise applications, VPN/ZTNA solutions, VDI/RDP


 environments, and endpoints.
   

  

* Monitor identity\-related security events, audit logs, and SIEM integrations.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, SOC, PAM, Application, and business teams on


 IAM initiatives.
   

  

* Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, and support


 runbooks.
   

  

* Participate in incident, problem, and change management activities and provide


 escalation/on\-call support when required.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\+ years of experience in Cybersecurity and Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Hybrid Identity Architecture.
* Experience managing Active Directory, Group Policies, Users, Groups, and


 Organizational Units (OUs).
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra Connect (Azure AD Connect).
* Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Access Reviews, and User Access


 Recertification.
   

  

* Experience with PIM, JIT Access, and privileged identity controls.
* Knowledge of authentication and identity technologies including SAML, OAuth, OpenID


 Connect (OIDC), LDAP, and Federation Services.
   

  

* Experience onboarding and integrating enterprise applications with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Knowledge of phishing\-resistant authentication technologies such as FIDO2, WebAuthn,


 Passkeys, Windows Hello for Business, Certificate\-Based Authentication, and Smart
   

  

 Cards.
   

  

* Strong troubleshooting skills for identity and access management issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Knowledge of service accounts, managed identities, gMSA, certificates, and machine


 identity management.
   

  

* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise PAM solutions.
* Exposure to SIEM platforms and identity security monitoring.
* Relevant Microsoft security or identity certifications are an added advantage.

title: Microsoft Teams Junior Technical Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Microsoft Teams Junior Technical Lead**
 with secondary Messaging and Exchange Online support
   

  

 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support our 400,000\+ EY people across more than 150 countries. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and top\-tier technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to create a superior customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business experts to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 Assist Global Technical Leads in the technical ownership and global technical management of the Microsoft Teams platform across EY. This is primarily a Teams role, spanning policy governance, feature enablement, application onboarding, federation and external access governance, operational coordination, and rollout validation. The role also includes a smaller, secondary Messaging footprint, supporting initial Exchange Online and Outlook triage, mail flow investigation, and coordination with the Messaging team when required.
   

  

 It partners closely with Product Managers, engineering, operations, and Microsoft to ensure consistent, compliant, and scalable configurations globally. Key is providing technical know\-how whilst understanding the complexities of the business, user experience and wide\-reaching technology integrations.
   

  

 Core responsibilities
   

  

* Support technical ownership of the Microsoft Teams platform, ensuring consistency across Teams Admin Center (TAC), PowerShell, provisioning systems, and alignment to global baseline configurations.
* Assist in designing, enforcing, and managing the lifecycle of global and country\-level Teams policies, including meetings, messaging, apps, external access, policy assignments, exception handling, and large\-scale policy transitions.
* Support Teams provisioning processes and Modern Enablement Tool (MET) alignment; validate that provisioning outcomes match expected policy behavior and troubleshoot inconsistencies between assigned and effective configurations.
* Act as a point of contact for developers requesting Teams\-related Microsoft Graph API permissions, guiding enterprise application registration activities and coordinating permission scope approvals with Information Security and API owners.
* Monitor Teams federation and external access usage, support removal of inactive domains, and maintain visibility into federation governance and recertification processes.
* Coordinate with engineering and operations on Teams feature enablement, platform changes, pilot programs, and readiness validation activities; identify and escalate platform inconsistencies to Microsoft and internal engineering teams.
* Coordinate and follow up on open Teams incidents, requests, and actions through to resolution; assist with testing, validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), and rollout readiness activities.
* Stay informed on Microsoft roadmap features affecting the Teams platform, validate documented behavior against real\-world results, and support preparation of technical updates and stakeholder communications including CLT decks, summaries, and briefings.
* Provide secondary support for Exchange Online and Outlook operations, including initial incident triage, mailbox and mail flow investigations, feature validation, and operational coordination with the Messaging team when required.


 Skills and attributes for success
   

  

 Technical
   

  

* Strong Microsoft Teams administration (TAC, policies, PowerShell)
* Solid understanding of Teams architecture: meetings, messaging, apps, federation, external access
* Microsoft Entra ID fundamentals (app registrations, service principals, group\-based assignment)
* Practical understanding of Microsoft Graph permissions (delegated vs application)
* Exposure to PowerShell for reporting and bulk management tasks (modifying and running scripts; not necessarily authoring from scratch)


 Messaging and Exchange Online Exposure
   

  

* Working knowledge of Exchange Online administration and mailbox lifecycle management
* Understanding of mail flow fundamentals, transport rules, connectors, and message trace
* Familiarity with Outlook clients and Exchange Online dependencies
* Basic awareness of Exchange Online Protection (EOP), anti\-spam controls, and retention concepts
* Identity integration awareness: Active Directory (AD), Microsoft Entra ID, directory sync (Microsoft Entra Connect), and authentication flow basics
* DNS (Domain Name System) and email authentication fundamentals: MX, SPF (Sender Policy Framework), DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail), and DMARC (Domain\-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance)


 Platform Governance
   

  

* Experience supporting enterprise policy enforcement at scale across collaboration platforms, with awareness of messaging policy and configuration impacts
* Understanding of external collaboration governance, app access control, and mail flow security controls
* Ability to evaluate policy and configuration impact across a global Teams environment, with secondary awareness of related Exchange Online dependencies


 Operational / Process
   

  

* Experience working within ITSM workflows (ServiceNow preferred) for Teams tickets, with exposure to Exchange/Outlook ticket coordination
* Exposure to structured change coordination across engineering and operations
* Familiarity with governance processes (app request intake, federation monitoring, policy lifecycle), with awareness of related messaging governance workflows
* Experience with structured testing, validation, and operational support processes for Teams incidents and pilot rollouts, with support\-level exposure to Exchange Online/Outlook validation


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Ability to operate in a support and enablement model under a Global Technical Lead
* Strong stakeholder coordination across Product Managers, developers, operations, and end users, primarily for Teams and secondarily for Exchange/Outlook issues
* Ability to guide and challenge developer requests appropriately
* Structured troubleshooting and analytical mindset
* Clear and precise technical communication


 To qualify for the role, you must have
   

  

* Bachelor or Masters degree in Information Technology, Business
* Experience with Microsoft cloud services, commercial \& sovereign based Office 365 tenants
* Approximately 3 years of experience in a comparable technical role


 Ideally, you’ll also have
   

  

* 3–6 years in Microsoft 365 administration, primarily spanning Teams with support\-level exposure to Exchange Online/Outlook platforms
* Hands\-on or support\-level experience troubleshooting Teams, with practical exposure to Exchange Online/Outlook, including comfort distinguishing client\-side vs. service\-side issues across Outlook variants
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale environments with global policy enforcement across Teams, with awareness of Exchange Online dependencies
* Exposure to app governance or identity\-related workflows
* Experience interacting with Microsoft engineering or product teams is beneficial


 What we look for
   

  

 We’re looking for a passionate, committed and curious individual with a deep interest in MS cloud\-based technologies and services. You should be prepared to work in a fast\-paced environment to tight timelines and rapid change as EY adapts to various regulations and demand from the business whilst maintaining integration across the differing platforms maintained by EY.
   

  

 What working at EY offers
   

  

 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
